<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 194.0862 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting a proton gives a neutral mass of ~193.079 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+2 intensity ≈ 33 % of M) indicates the presence of one chlorine atom. Solving for a formula CxHyOzCl that matches this exact mass yields the best fit as C₈H₁₄O₃Cl, whose calculated monoisotopic mass is 193.0631 Da, within typical experimental error for the observed value.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14O3Cl</final_answer>
